name: run

test_list.description: Real binary reports the provider after successful installation.
Real binary persists local session controls and emits real JSONL events.
Model work outside P1 fails explicitly.
Fresh offline CLI state keeps its persistent status out of the notice row.
Unsupported model task execution retains the exact draft and gives a concise explanation.
The /clear command clears visible conversation and dismisses the current notice.
Slash command suggestions reach the rendered frame and Tab accepts a unique prefix.
Automatic color depth uses Windows VT capability and preserves ANSI/no-color overrides.
Footer Help, mode, model and effort controls respond to mouse clicks with real local behavior.
Clipboard-unavailable feedback remains visible after Ctrl+V and cursor navigation; a successful text edit clears it. Mode preference feedback is not erased by shared dispatch cleanup.

output_description: Actual durable events or a typed failure; no synthetic completion.
